fusions.name: Drawn Thread
fusions.desc: Sends a strand into the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Snared Mass
fusions.desc: Casts a web of strands around you, dealing 24 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignoring their resistances. Each has a 60% chance of being [Slowed] for 6 seconds. You restore 14 health.

fusions.name: Stitch in Time
fusions.desc: Restores 22 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Spun Thread
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once and heal you for 3% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
